responsibility: Defines the built-in default header search directory table used by preprocessing setup and exports the configured installation-prefix constants that describe GCC’s include layout. It owns the cpp_include_defaults array, including C++-specific, fixincludes, sysrooted, multilib, and native-system entries selected from configuration macros, and provides cpp_relocated to detect a relocated toolchain via GCC_EXEC_PREFIX so include-path construction can adjust standard include handling accordingly.
same_name_distinction: This is the data-and-implementation file in the cppdefault pair: it defines the configured cpp_include_defaults table, exports concrete prefix constants, and implements cpp_relocated to detect a relocated installation. Unlike gcc/cppdefault.h, it does not merely describe struct default_include and declare these symbols; it supplies the actual built-in include-directory data and relocation behavior.
